summary: The registrant filed a Form 6-K on April 21, 2026, announcing the termination of a Sales Agreement (ATM offering) with A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners originally dated December 11, 2025, for up to $200 million of ordinary shares. As of termination, 5,666,684 shares were sold under the program. The termination is effective immediately with no further sales. No new special situation—such as a strategic transaction or significant corporate action—is triggered. The filing is a routine update ending a prior shelf-takedown program; no premium, price terms, or strategic shift are implied. Watch for any subsequent financing needs or corporate restructurings.
